attackers_goals: Adversaries may hide their malicious Scheduled Task to evade detection.
description: Attackers may try to hide a Scheduled Task by deleting the Scheduled Task's software descriptor (SD) value in the registry.
investigative_actions: Check the appropriate Scheduled Task to verify its legitimacy. You can also check the executing executable to verify its purpose.
name: Scheduled Task hidden by registry modification
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
